descriptionChirho: A masculine proper name meaning 'God has protected' (from אֵל 'God' + צָפַן 'to hide/protect'), borne by at least two individuals in the Hebrew Bible: (a) the chief of the Kohathite clan of Levites (Num 3:30, 34:25; 1 Chr 15:8; 2 Chr 29:13), and (b) a son of Uzziel mentioned in Exodus 6:22 and Leviticus 10:4. The name appears in two orthographic variants: the longer form אֱלִיצָפָן (Elizaphan) in Numbers and Chronicles, and the shorter form אֶלְצָפָן (Elzaphan) in Exodus and Leviticus. All four clusters represent the same proper noun referring to the same person(s), with differences arising solely from orthographic variation and prefixed conjunctions/prepositions, not from distinct senses.
